name: @team-antioch/sc2-adjutant-host-windows
description: The Windows Host Adapter Plugin for sc2-adjutant: opens the Galaxy Editor, runs Test Document and saves a copy of a map there, captures camera tours, starts the game and captures its window, speaks placeholder voice lines and renders game models.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "require('node:fs').cpSync('helpers', 'dist/helpers', { recursive: true })" && node ../core/scripts/write-built-stamp.mjs
